content.title: Dual-Character Title Convergence | Separate Credits, Foreground Wipes, Master Lockup
content.summary: Two harbor workers move from separate credit entrances to one lighthouse-route title lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Each adult receives one distinct identity-credit entrance. + Foreground objects motivate every chapter handoff. + Identity, wardrobe and signature prop remain registered. + Separate routes visibly converge into one shared axis. + The final master title holds with both adults and the destination.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on an original cliff tram crossing frame before one adult ceramicist appears in a turquoise studio doorway under the exact credit MARA VALE. Use the tram edge, doorway and map roll as three motivated foreground wipes while each face, wardrobe and prop remains registered. Hold the pair beneath the exact original title TIDE BETWEEN US with sea, lighthouse and both identity anchors visible.
